title: CommunicationFollowUpRequest
description: Validation rules for creating a follow-up task linked to a communication event. F0021-S0005. The resulting TaskItem.LinkedEntityType is set to 'CommunicationEvent' and TaskItem.LinkedEntityId to the communication event ID. Only one follow-up per event in MVP (error code: follow_up_exists if already set).

title.description: Task title. Required. Error code: title_required.

dueDate.description: Optional due date (ISO 8601 date only, e.g. 2026-05-14).

assignedToUserId.description: Optional internal UserId from UserProfile. Defaults to the current authenticated user if omitted.

priority.description: Task priority. Defaults to Normal. Error code: invalid_priority.
